class: A wait for the owner judged the page from one look taken as the wait began
symptom: Mutual of Enumclaw (iCIMS), 29 September: the run stopped for a CAPTCHA, the owner solved it, the site moved on, and the run went on waiting for a Continue that never came.
site: iCIMS (hCaptcha); any site whose challenge redraws itself
root_cause: _wait_for_signal decided whether it was waiting on a CAPTCHA from one safety.captcha_visible look as the wait began. hCaptcha's picture puzzle redraws itself; that one look fell between draws, so the wait was treated as an ordinary 'waiting for your instruction' and never watched for the challenge to be done -- although the run had stopped precisely because of it.
why_tests_missed: The CAPTCHA-wait test put the challenge on the page before the wait began and kept it there until solved; no test drew it late, or told the wait why the run had stopped.
fix: apply_flow passes for_captcha when the stop was for a CAPTCHA. The wait then watches for the whole wait: it carries on by itself once the CAPTCHA has been seen and then seen gone on two looks, and never carries on for a challenge it has not seen (no guessing that it was solved).
prevention: A wait carries the reason it began; what it waits for is watched for the whole wait, never decided from the page at one instant -- and never assumed done without having been seen.
